# Golden Square Mile Hospitalité (GSMH)

> Montréal developer of fine-dining restaurants and healthy fast-casual concepts, founded in 2011 by restaurateur Imad Nabwani. Owns and operates Le Pois Penché (Parisian brasserie) and Tropé Jus & Snackbar in the Golden Square Mile; also delivers concept development, management and consulting mandates for third parties (Restaurant Henri at Hôtel Birks, Restaurant Gustave at Hôtel Le Saint-Martin, Hôtel Chez Swann).

Address: 1230 boul. De Maisonneuve Ouest, Montréal, QC H3G 1M2
Phone: 514-667-5050
Email: imad.nabwani@gsmh.ca
Portfolio sites: https://lepoispenche.com · https://tropevie.com
Concepts in development: a new breed of steakhouse, a casual French brasserie for multi-unit rollout, a Syrian rotisserie.
